mapper.insert: insert into wf_integration_credential (credential_name, token_prefix, token_hash, scopes, allowed_variables, rate_limit_per_minute, rate_window_start, rate_window_count, expires_at, revoked_at, revision_no, create_by, create_time) values (#{credentialName}, #{tokenPrefix}, #{tokenHash}, #{scopes}, #{allowedVariables}, #{rateLimitPerMinute}, current_timestamp(3), 0, #{expiresAt}, null, 1, #{createBy}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.update: update wf_integration_credential set token_prefix = #{item.tokenPrefix}, token_hash = #{item.tokenHash}, expires_at = #{item.expiresAt}, revision_no = #{item.revisionNo}, rate_window_start = current_timestamp(3), rate_window_count = 0, update_by = #{item.updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where credential_id = #{item.credentialId} and revision_no = #{expectedRevision} and revoked_at is null
